question: How does a registered native page navigate to another page of the same app with the stock page transition, and how is a page popped back?
callsite_evidence: sub_CA54998 (navigate) resolves the composite page key and calls sub_CA53D30, which forwards to sub_CA539F8; the launcher show_app sub_CA54338 and stock Settings sub-page rows also converge on sub_CA539F8
sub_CA539F8 walks the registered-page registry comparing the 32-bit composite key at descriptor +20 and returns early when the target already is the current top page
sub_CA539F8 pauses the current page, pushes the target page through sub_CA5362C (push_page_to_app_stack), and runs the transition coordinator sub_CA52CF8
sub_CA52CF8 calls off_200EB058[13](app_id) to select the opening-transition path, matching EVID-APP-008's system-range behavior for app_id 0x00CA

sub_CA546CC (page_system_back_handler / handle_touchpad_left_event) checks page flags at +24 and the in-animation state before walking the parent chain for a back callback at descriptor +104; with no handler it calls sub_CA53088 finish_page
sub_CA53088 finish_page pops the referenced page, resumes the page below it via sub_CA526E4, and runs destroy cleanup; it logs 'finish the no stack top page' for invalid calls
control_flow_evidence: sub_CA54998 only navigates when the target app is not already running in off_200EB044's registry, so composite-key navigation must target the page_goto core directly for intra-app navigation
Forward navigation pauses the source page instead of destroying it, so the /dev/canopus client fd remains valid across page transitions and is released only when the last page of the app is finished
page_goto deduplicates against the current top page, so a page that is already shown must be re-rendered rather than pushed again
The Manager registers three pages of app 0x00CA (overview page_id 0, modules page_id 1, detail page_id 2); forward rows push the target page, backward rows call page_finish on the current page
ownership_analysis: Page descriptors are static and live for the app lifetime. page_goto references pages by composite key resolved against the firmware page registry; page_finish references the descriptor directly. The pushed page's on_create allocates its LVX root; finish drives on_destroy. Manager page contexts are resident and cleared only on their own on_destroy.
unsafe_assumptions: page_goto/page_finish behavior is statically recovered from stock pagemanager call sites but has not yet been device-probed for the Manager's own pages
The transition coordinator's per-app transition selection for app_id 0x00CA and the exact back-gesture wiring on a dynamically registered app are device-gated
If page_goto refuses navigation (page not registered), the backend falls back to rendering the target view in place on the current page
recommended_probe: Reboot, LOAD, INSTALL, open Manager, tap Modules, tap a module, then use the explicit back rows and the system back gesture; verify each transition, that the /dev/canopus fd survives page switches, and that 100 forward/back cycles do not leak rows or crash.
